thread:
mira: bringing up mistralx-v2 (int4) on dedicated. quick chat smoke tests show repeating blocks when context > ~8k. short repro attached below.
alex: can you paste a minimal prompt that reproduces? deterministic across seeds?
sam: saw something like this last month when tokenizer fallback produced duplicated token ids, maybe kv index collision.
mira: here's a tiny repro (ran on prod-like build):
```python
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.from_file('mistralx_vocab.json')
s = 'User: ' + 'word ' * 1200 + '\nAssistant: '
ids = t.encode(s).ids
print(len(ids), ids[-10:])
# then send to runtime with kv reuse
```
jin: interesting — when I diff the ids against the same string on our python tokenizer vs rust binding there's an offset after rare byte sequences. looks like some multibyte pretokenization path fell back to a different normalization step.
mira: metrics: canary-run QA macro prompts -> BLEU-ish proxy dropped 0.09; generation shows verbatim repetition starting at token ~8123.
infra-bot: canary: mistralx-v2-int4 (canary-17) - perf ok, quality check failed (score 0.82 -> 0.73). logs: kv-cache index OOB warnings (x12).
alex: kv-cache OOB warnings would cause rogue reuse of old KV entries -> repetition. could be token id remap / vocab aliasing problem during token->position mapping.
sam: two quick hypotheses: 1) tokenizer produced alias ids above model.vocab_size leading to wrap-around in kv buffer, 2) rotary/position scaling code assumes contiguous token ids and miscomputes head offsets for >vocab_boundary.
jin: I instrumented the runtime: when token_id >= model.vocab_size we do `token_id % vocab_size` in one path but not the other. that explains intermittent aliasing.
mira: wow. that explains why only long contexts fail (rare tokens appear later). Could be introduced by our new fallback normalizer for emoji sequences.
alex: possible fixes: normalize tokenization to never emit out-of-range ids (preferred), or ensure runtime paths use consistent remap table, or expand kv index checks + assert to catch earlier.
sam: quick patch idea: in tokenizer wrapper add `if id >= vocab_size: id = remap_table.get(id, unk_id)` and rerun canary.
jin: I ran a local repro with remap table applied — repetition disappears in 10/10 runs. quality proxy back to baseline.
mira: nice. can we add unit test for rare multibyte sequence that previously fell through? also add runtime assert to log full token id and position when kv OOB occurs.
